title: bgvars: Bayesian Inference of Global Vector Autoregressive and Global Vector Error Correction Models
description: An R package that assists in the set-up and inference of Bayesian global vector autoregressive (BGVAR) and global vector error correction (BGVEC) models. It provides functions for the construction of country models from regional data and weight matrices, prior specification, posterior simulation of the sub-models, their combination into a global model, and impulse response analysis and forecast error variance decomposition of the result. Sub-models can be estimated in batches and stored as HDF5 files, so that a global model larger than memory can be worked through one sub-model at a time.
